scope: Three separate fixed-geometry models, each four training and two existing validation exposures. No pairs/tests. Whole180s autonomous rollout. Outputs regional temperatures and wet+solid masses only; no heat/fuel/flame prediction.
selection: Temperature MAE/1000 + mass-fraction MAE, averaged equally over validation configurations. Existing validation reused; exploratory comparison, no new independent test.
constraints: Mass in[0,1], nonincreasing; temperature >=0C for these ambient20C experiments. Not energy conservation or complete physical validity.
